entries.causal_explanation: The only intended variable was one quote-specific instruction; paired evidence is consistent with a prompt effect.
entries.confidence_justification: Both paired targeted scenarios improved, but one run cannot exclude provider stochasticity.
entries.description: The H2 quote-specific instruction removed both observed primary QUOTE_MUTATION failures.
entries.observed_behavior: QUOTE_MUTATION decreased from two scenarios to zero.
entries.recommended_usage: Retain as evidence that quote handling is prompt-responsive, not as proof of production suitability.
entries.title: Quote-specific preservation reduced quote mutation

entries.causal_explanation: The paired treatment improved its target but SYN-20 regressed across four criteria; prompt interaction and stochasticity remain alternatives.
entries.confidence_justification: The transition counts are deterministic; causal attribution of the new failures remains lower confidence.
entries.description: H2 resolved two criterion failures but introduced four, producing net utility minus two.
entries.observed_behavior: Two resolved scenario-criterion failures were offset by four introduced failures.
entries.recommended_usage: Require multi-criterion trade-off review before promoting a targeted prompt improvement.
side_effects: Editorial acceptance decreased from one pass to zero.
entries.title: Narrow target improvement can have negative net editorial utility

entries.causal_explanation: Failure prioritization exposed authority failures already present in control evidence; H2 did not cure them.
entries.confidence_justification: Primary-category substitution is observed, but its causal mechanism was not independently tested.
entries.description: SOURCE_AUTHORITY_DRIFT replaced QUOTE_MUTATION as primary in two scenarios without introducing the underlying authority criteria.
entries.observed_behavior: Resolving quote preservation changed the primary failure label while the scenarios remained rejected.
entries.recommended_usage: Inspect criterion-level transitions whenever a primary failure category disappears.
side_effects: Primary-category frequency can obscure unchanged secondary failures.
entries.title: Removing quote failure exposed pre-existing authority failure

entries.causal_explanation: Acceptance is a terminal judgment rather than a diagnostic decomposition.
entries.confidence_justification: The frozen H2 evidence contains the same zero treatment passes alongside both improvements and regressions.
entries.description: Aggregate acceptance alone cannot identify resolved, substituted, or introduced editorial failures.
entries.observed_behavior: One aggregate acceptance value coexisted with two resolved and four introduced criterion failures.
entries.recommended_usage: Always retain criterion and transition diagnostics beside acceptance counts.
entries.title: Editorial acceptance requires criterion-level explanation

entries.causal_explanation: The metric counts compensating criterion changes without replacing the frozen acceptance gate.
entries.confidence_justification: The metric is deterministically reconstructed from all 24 paired criterion transitions.
entries.description: Scenario-criterion resolutions minus introductions exposes compensating changes hidden by acceptance.
entries.observed_behavior: Net Editorial Utility was minus two while targeted quote behavior improved.
entries.recommended_usage: Use as a diagnostic paired metric alongside, never instead of, acceptance.
side_effects: It must not replace editorial acceptance.
entries.title: Net Editorial Utility supplements editorial acceptance

entries.causal_explanation: Restricting the intended variable makes claims narrower, though it does not eliminate stochastic uncertainty.
entries.confidence_justification: The manifest verifies a one-of-one budget and frozen technical variables; provider stochasticity still limits attribution.
entries.description: H2 changed one documented behavioral mechanism and preserved all technical contracts.
entries.observed_behavior: One prompt mechanism was evaluated with 24/24 technical and reference preservation.
entries.recommended_usage: Keep future prompt experiments within a precommitted semantic delta budget.
side_effects: A narrow mechanism may optimize only one criterion.
entries.title: Single-mechanism prompt budgets bound causal interpretation

entries.causal_explanation: Typed invariants and raw-byte artifact fingerprints detect inconsistent reconstruction.
entries.confidence_justification: Deterministic fingerprint and artifact validation are enforced by executable contracts and tests.
entries.description: The Part 7H.2 manifest validates identity, lineage, gates, results, decision, and nine supporting artifacts.
entries.observed_behavior: One canonical manifest reconstructs and validates the complete H2 experiment state.
entries.recommended_usage: Create and validate a canonical manifest before extracting reusable knowledge.
entries.title: Canonical manifests make experiment conclusions reproducible

entries.causal_explanation: A single balanced-preservation rule was the intended variable; its broader scenario effect and remaining regressions make the exact mechanism only partially confirmed.
entries.confidence_justification: The paired 24-scenario experiment is technically complete, while the predicted causal mechanism was only partially confirmed.
entries.description: H3 increased editorial acceptance and produced Net Editorial Utility +8 while preserving technical and reference contracts.
entries.observed_behavior: H3 resolved 13 scenario-criterion failures, introduced five, and increased acceptance from one to three passes.
entries.recommended_usage: Use as evidence for balanced multi-criterion preservation and retain predictive uncertainty in future experiments.
side_effects: One control pass still became a treatment failure.
entries.title: Balanced preservation produced positive multi-criterion utility

relationships.explanation: The trade-off calculation depends on the targeted quote resolution.
Criterion evidence refines what the primary quote-category reduction means.
Net utility supplies the diagnostic decomposition acceptance lacks.
The bounded prompt delta supports narrow interpretation of the quote finding.
Manifest validation preserves the frozen variables required by the delta budget.
H3 validates that the H2 trade-off can be improved while retaining residual regressions and broader-than-predicted effects.
